  "notes": "Target requires blending pre-retirement (active) and post-retirement (retiree) mortality. The document provides explicit sample rates for Pre-Retirement (ages 20-64) in a table on page 92. It provides only descriptive text for Post-Retirement (Healthy, Disabled, Beneficiary) on page 91, with no numerical sample rates. Therefore, the blended column can only be constructed for ages 20-64 using the Pre-Retirement rates. For ages 65+, the target is unavailable as no numerical post-retirement rates are provided to blend. The 'group_weighted' operation uses the Active Member counts (Table 5) as weights for the Pre-Retirement Male/Female columns. Since no Post-Retirement numerical rates exist, the Post-Retirement component of the blend is effectively zero for the calculation, leaving the Pre-Retirement rate as the result for ages 20-64. The weights table (Table 5) has row_spans defined to map its bins to the target ages. The 'values_unit' is 'percent' as the source rates are printed as 0.04, 0.02, etc., representing percentages (e.g., 0.04%). The target grid rows 65-119 have empty sources because the source table ends at age 64 and no other source provides rates for older ages."
